# truenas_mail (Data Source)

Reads the current TrueNAS system mail (email) configuration. Takes no arguments: there is exactly one mail configuration per TrueNAS system. Does not expose the SMTP password: mail.config never returns it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `fromemail` (String) "From" address used on outgoing mail.
- `fromname` (String) "From" display name used on outgoing mail.
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton: always "mail".
- `outgoingserver` (String) Outgoing SMTP server hostname.
- `port` (Number) Outgoing SMTP server port.
- `security` (String) SMTP transport security: one of PLAIN, SSL, TLS.
- `smtp` (Boolean) Whether SMTP authentication is enabled.
- `user` (String) SMTP authentication username.
